sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Sales of Maternity and Infant Care Commodities

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with German and Japanese legal influences under the Taisho-era Japanese Commercial Code lineage, as codified in the Taiwanese Company Act and Civil Code)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) — Investment Chapter (2010)
Cross-Strait Bilateral Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (2012, signed between the Straits Exchange Foundation and Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits)
WTO Accession Commitments (WTO Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu)
APEC Membership Commitments (non-binding investment facilitation principles)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Control Act (MLCA), as amended 2023; Regulations Governing the Review of Foreign Investment (MOEA Investment Commission); Directions Governing the Declaration of Beneficial Ownership of Companies (Ministry of Economic Affairs Order, issued under the Company Act Art. 22-1); Enforcement Rules of the Investment Commission for Mainland Area Investment; Company Act Art. 22-1 (Shareholder and Beneficial Owner Register maintenance obligation for all companies incorporated in Taiwan).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Mainland Commercial Entity Business License (notarized copy with English translation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Mainland Administration for Market Regulation (State Administration for Market Regulation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Document Authentication via Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification after Mainland notarization; not subject to Hague Apostille because Taiwan is not a Hague Convention party and cross-strait consular legalization is unavailable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of all Mainland direct shareholders (Chinese business registration certificate)
Articles of Association / Organizational Charter of the Mainland parent entity
Board Resolution or Shareholders' Written Consent approving the Taiwan WFOE incorporation and designated representative appointment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Mainland Parent Board of Directors / Shareholders' Meeting

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Chinese (Mainland) passport and national ID card copy of proposed Taiwan WFOE director / supervisor / senior manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Mainland Ministry of Public Security / Notary Public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Declaration and Crystallized UBO Chain Statement covering all natural persons holding 25% or more equity interest
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Mainland ultimate shareholder(s) and Taiwan incorporation counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by Taiwan District Court-certified notary public; no foreign legalization required for this internal declaration

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory Customer Due Diligence under MLCA Art. 8: identify and verify beneficial owners of all legal persons; Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) screening against the domestic PEP list published by the Ministry of Justice (AMLD) and the international FATF-recognized PEP databases. Mandatory cross-checks against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Taiwan's domestic Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Watchlist maintained by the Financial Supervisory Commission. The Investment Commission of the MOEA additionally screens Mainland investors' shareholder background for negative media exposure, adverse official records, and sanctions flags before issuing FIA approval. Wire transfer and beneficiary name-screening obligations apply with continuous monitoring at onboarding and on each transaction under MLCA Art. 9 and the Banking AML Regulations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: MOEA Company Registration and Name Reservation System (Company Registration Review System, 商工登記公示資料查詢服務 and Company Name Reservation Online Application Portal of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commerce)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Taiwanese Company Act Art. 18, the Chinese company name is the statutory registration name and must not be misleading or conflict with an existing identical or materially similar registered name. The English name is a supplementary registration; where a foreign company letter (Certificate of English Name) is procured, the English name must be a direct translation or transliteration corresponding to the Chinese statutory name, otherwise the registration authority will require a written explanation of non-equivalence.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 金控 (Financial Holding) — requires FSC approval
基金管理 (Fund Management) — requires FSC approval
政府 / 中央 / 國營 (Government / Central / State-run) — prohibited as misleading
基金會 (Foundation) — prohibited unless registered as a foundation
財團法人 (Juridical Foundation) — prohibited for ordinary companies
社團法人 (Juridical Association) — prohibited for ordinary companies
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Under Company Act Art. 18, a company name reservation may be extended once for an additional 180 days upon application before expiry; if the extension period expires, the applicant may submit a fresh name reservation request (subject to re-check of availability). Upon rejection, the applicant or a licensed incorporation agent must file a written petition for re-examination with the MOEA Central Region Office (Department of Commerce) within 30 days, stating the grounds of non-confusion and submitting a formal legal argument on the identical/similarity assessment; if the re-examination is denied, an administrative appeal must be lodged with the Executive Yuan within 30 days of the denial notice; subsequent judicial review lies with the Taipei High Administrative Court. In parallel, the applicant should file a new reservation request for a backup name without waiting for the appeal outcome to avoid project delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible on a limited basis. A Taiwan-registered company must have a physical office with actual lease rights and a registered address; however, for the low-risk e-commerce sector (ISIC 4791), the Investment Commission and local municipal registration authorities generally accept a dedicated virtual-office or serviced-office arrangement within a registered commercial building, provided there is a valid service agreement, a letter of consent from the landlord or building manager, and the address is not a mere mail-forwarding PO Box. The virtual office provider must be a licensed registered address service or a professional office-spaces operator.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-Moderate; approximately 5-15% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection during the first two operating years. The likelihood rises if the applicant company applies for special foreign-investment incentives, engages physical inventory storage, or triggers any AML/CFT red flags. The MOEA Commercial and Industrial Registration Inspectorate, the Investment Commission, the National Taxation Bureau, and the FSC may conduct ad hoc verification on registered-office presence, personnel staffing, and business substance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name availability search and pre-screening (MOEA online search)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) — online portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee: no statutory charge; free public database

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name reservation fee (180-day reservation, first term)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce / Central Region Office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee: NT$300 per filing (approx. USD 10), Company Act Art. 18 (registration charge schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mainland notarization and authentication of corporate documents (business license, certificate of incorporation, articles, board resolution, passport copies)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Mainland notary offices and Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market and statutory notarization tariff in mainland China (varies by notary office) + SEF verification fee approx. NT$300 per authenticated set (approx. USD 10); range USD 250-450 for a 5-document bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Investment Commission (MOEA FIA) foreign investment approval application fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs Investment Commission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee for foreign/investment approval application: NT$500 (approx. USD 16), pursuant to the fee schedule of the Investment Commission

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company incorporation registration fee (WFOE limited liability company with paid-in capital typically under NT$400 million)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: MOEA Central Region Office / local Commercial Registration Authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee: NT$1,000 license registration fee (approx. USD 32) plus NT$10 for share certificate book fee (approx. USD 3); total approx. USD 35, Company Act Art. 438 and registration fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office / virtual office service provider (dedicated commercial address and lease consent for first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: USD 200-500 annually in Taipei / New Taipei Area for a low-risk e-commerce registered address service

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional legal retainer for pre-incorporation due diligence, UBO structure chart, constitutional document drafting, cross-strait document authentication coordination, and incorporation filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border WFOE incorporation in Taiwan: USD 800-1,500 per engagement (non-regulatory tariff, private legal fee agreement)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Republic of China (Taiwan) Company Act, Articles 129-132, 154, 161, 172, 387 and 393; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, Articles 4 and 7; Criterion Governing the Approval of Investment by Mainland Area Investors (where ultimate parent is a mainland China entity); Regulation on Company Registration Fees; Commodity Inspection Act, Article 6; Building Act, Article 73; Fire Services Act, Articles 10-13; Occupational Safety and Health Act, Articles 5-6.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Commercial Development Administration, Companies Registration Division; electronic filing is conducted through the MOEA Company and Business One-Stop Online Registration System.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Registration Application (Company Incorporation Registration Application Form) together with the attested Articles of Incorporation, supporting capital verification documents, foreign-investment approval letter, and corporate seal card.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a Taiwan company limited by shares under the Company Act; however, the foreign investor must obtain prior approval from the MOEA Investment Commission and remit the full approved amount into a New Taiwan Dollar deposit account held in the company's name at a licensed Taiwan bank. The remittance must be verified by a Taiwan-certified public accountant in a capital verification report before incorporation registration. If the ultimate investor is a mainland China entity, the investment must additionally satisfy the positive-list review and quota rules under the Act Governing Relations between Peoples of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area and its approval criterion.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME, TAIWAN WFOE] - ADOPTED IN WRITING ON [DATE]. WHEREAS the sole shareholder has resolved to incorporate a Taiwan limited-liability WFOE, IT IS RESOLVED: (1) the Articles of Incorporation tabled are adopted and the statutory business scope fixed; (2) the approved paid-in capital is subscribed in full by the sole shareholder; (3) the registered office is fixed at [TAIWAN ADDRESS]; (4) [NAME] and [NAME] are elected directors, and [NAME] is appointed Chairperson and statutory responsible person; (5) the Taiwan CPA firm and filing agent are appointed; and (6) the Chairperson is authorized to execute, stamp, and file all incorporation, tax, banking, social-insurance, customs, and licensing documents. CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Pre-Check and Business Scope Classification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Commercial Development Administration - corporate name pre-approval module of the Company and Business One-Stop Online Registration System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application for pre-approved company name and business scope classification before incorporation. Propose three alternative Chinese names and confirm the English name. Map the intended online sale of maternity and infant care commodities to the applicable Company Act business item codes and verify that no international e-commerce licensing restriction applies to the designated scope. Download the name pre-approval certificate for attachment to the later registration filing.
required_dossiers: Company Name Pre-Check Application Form
Proposed Chinese and English company names with three alternates
Business scope classification codes aligned to the Company Act business item schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for confusing similarity or incomplete scope codes, the applicant files a curative re-application with a secondary name within 30 days of the deficiency notice; an adverse name decision may be contested by an administrative appeal to MOEA within 30 days of receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inward Foreign Investment Approval by the Investment Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Investment Commission (Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the foreign-investment approval application, designating the Taiwan WFOE as the investee and the foreign corporate parent as the investing shareholder. The application must include the investment amount, capital structure, business plan, and source-of-funds statement. Mainland China ultimate investors are subject to an additional negative-list and positive-list review; this dossier assumes either approval under the approved route or a third-country holding structure that is itself approved under applicable rules.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Application Form
Certificate of incorporation and latest audited financial statements of the investing parent (notarized and apostilled/legalized as applicable)
Board or shareholder resolution of the parent authorizing the investment
Detailed investment and business plan with source-of-funds statement
Notarized power of attorney in favor of Taiwan counsel and local filing agent
Mainland-investor compliance statement and quota/positive-list self-assessment, where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a deferral notice or requests rectification, the applicant must cure the deficiencies within 60 days; a refusal may be appealed administratively to the Minister of Economic Affairs within 30 days after notice, and the permitted remittance timeline may be extended upon documented bank delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Formation Documents, Capital Remittance, and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Taiwan bank (for the NT-dollar capital account) and a Taiwan-certified public accountant (for capital verification)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After investment approval, execute the Articles of Incorporation and the First Board Resolution. Open a temporary NT-dollar capital receipt account at a Taiwan bank, quote the Investment Commission approval number, and receive the parent's cross-border wire remittance. Obtain the bank deposit certificate and instruct the appointed Taiwan CPA to verify the receipt and issue the capital verification report, which records that the full approved capital is paid in cash and remains unwithdrawn.
required_dossiers: Approved inward-investment letter from the Investment Commission
Executed Articles of Incorporation and First Board Resolution
Bank certificate of NT-dollar capital receipt and foreign-exchange settlement record
CPA capital verification report
Parent company remittance instruction and overseas bank advice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the banking counterparty questions the source of funds, the applicant submits the sealed foreign-exchange declaration and the Investment Commission approval letter to the bank's compliance unit; if the remittance timeline lapses, a written extension request is filed with the Investment Commission before the deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Company Incorporation Registration with MOEA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Commercial Development Administration, Companies Registration Division - One-Stop Online Registration System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation registration application electronically, attaching the capital verification report, Articles of Incorporation, name pre-approval certificate, inward-investment approval letter, director consent statements, and registered-office proof. Pay the NT-dollar filing fee by online transfer. Upon approval, download the company registration certificate and receive the company's unified corporate identification number. The company is legally established on the date of registration.
required_dossiers: Company Incorporation Registration Application Form
Articles of Incorporation attested by all shareholders/promoters
CPA capital verification report and bank certificate
Company Name Pre-Check approval letter
Investment Commission approval letter
Directors' consent letters and the resident director's proof of Taiwan residence
Corporate seal card and responsible-person seal certificate
Board Resolution appointing the Chairperson and responsible person
Office lease agreement or ownership certificate of the registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where MOEA issues a deficiency notice, the applicant has up to 15 days to rectify and re-submit; if registration is refused on substantive grounds, an administrative appeal to the Ministry of Economic Affairs may be filed within 30 days, and a fresh filing may be made once the defective items are lawfully cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Tax, Uniform Invoice, and Customs Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Administration (tax jurisdiction of the registered office) and Customs Administration, MOF, for import-export registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the business tax registration for value-added and non-value-added business tax purposes, obtain the unified invoice number and confirm eligibility to issue electronic uniform invoices. If the WFOE imports or exports maternity and infant commodities, register as an importer/exporter with the Customs Administration. For any regulated commodity (e.g., feeding bottles, pacifiers, baby strollers), complete the BSMI commodity inspection registration in parallel with the import registration.
required_dossiers: Company registration certificate and incorporation approval letter
Business Tax Registration Application Form (taxpayer entity registration)
Lease agreement or premise ownership proof for the tax authority
Documents for purchase and issuance of uniform invoices
Importer/Exporter Registration Application for cross-border trade
Identification and visa/ARC documents of the responsible person and tax filer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority questions the physical business premise, the applicant submits the lease, floor plan, and site photos; customs deficiencies may be cured by re-filing within 7 days; a refused tax registration is appealable to the National Taxation Administration within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Configurations: Seal, Bank Account Activation, and Social Insurance Units
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate bank (operational accounts), Bureau of Labor Insurance, National Health Insurance Administration, and municipal labor inspection authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the corporate operating bank account in NT dollars and any foreign-currency settlement account after issuance of the certificate of incorporation. Carve the official company seal and responsible-person seal in accordance with the registered seal card. Register the employer unit with the Bureau of Labor Insurance for labor insurance and labor pension and with the National Health Insurance Administration for insured-unit registration after the first employee is hired. Appoint the labor safety and health management officer once headcount reaches 31 or more, and file the safety plan with the municipal labor inspection authority.
required_dossiers: Company registration certificate
Corporate seal certificate and seal card
Bank account opening forms and board resolution on bank signatories
Employer unit registration forms for labor insurance, labor pension, and national health insurance
Employee roster for the first insured employees
Appointment record of the labor-safety management officer and workplace hazard assessment plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the labor authority queries the insurance unit registration, the employer submits the revised payroll and roster within 14 days; a failure to open the corporate bank account due to verification issues is cured by presenting the original certificate of incorporation and the responsible person's passport/ARC to the bank's compliance unit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Bureau of Standards, Metrology and Inspection (BSMI), together with the municipal Fire Department and municipal Building Administration for physical-site clearances of the office, warehouse, and distribution premises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Mandatory Commodity Inspection Registration and Commodity Inspection Mark for regulated infant and maternity commodities (e.g., feeding bottles, pacifiers, strollers, baby carriers, and children's toys falling within the BSMI inspection scope). Pure e-commerce resale of non-regulated goods does not require a separate industrial operating permit; the warehouse and office premises must, however, hold a lawful building usage license and a fire-safety report.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment (Taiwan), formerly Environmental Protection Administration, Environmental Management Division, acting through its regional environment and air-quality management offices.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full Environmental Impact Assessment Report: the WFOE's warehousing and mail-order/internet distribution model is not listed in the EIA Act schedule for mandatory EIA. The facility is nevertheless subject to fixed-source pollution registration if aggregate equipment capacity or storage quantities exceed the Air Pollution Control Act permitting thresholds, and to a wastewater discharge permit if any process wastewater is generated.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Sanitary wastewater must be discharged to the public sewer in conformity with the Sewer Act connection permit or, where sewer connection is unavailable, treated to the Water Pollution Control Act effluent standards (COD equal to or below 100 mg/L and SS equal to or below 30 mg/L for domestic-scale discharges). General industrial waste, including packaging waste and returned-goods waste, must be registered and disposed of through licensed waste handlers under the Waste Disposal Act. Stationary sources, if any, must comply with the Air Pollution Control Act VOC and particulate thresholds; refrigeration equipment must use HCFC-free refrigerants consistent with the Montreal Protocol implementation rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The office and warehouse must pass a fire-safety inspection under the Fire Services Act, including installation of fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, and exit signage, and the annual submission of the fire-safety equipment inspection report. The building must maintain a lawful usage license under the Building Act consistent with the declared 'office/warehouse' use. Under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, the employer must conduct a workplace physical-hazard assessment, appoint a labor-safety and health management officer when headcount reaches 31 or more, maintain first-aid and emergency-response arrangements, and keep the labor inspection records available for municipal inspection.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局). Official portal: https://www.chinatax.gov.cn. Electronic tax filing is administered through the provincial Electronic Tax Administration (电子税务局) portals and the China Tax Service application.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: After the WFOE obtains its business license from the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), it must complete tax registration within 30 days at the competent local tax bureau of the State Taxation Administration. Required submissions include the business license, articles of association, legal representative identity certificate, registered address proof, bank account opening certificate, and shareholder information. The tax authority issues a Unified Social Credit Code (统一社会信用代码), which serves as the sole taxpayer identification number for corporate income tax, VAT, stamp duty, and payroll withholding. The enterprise must separately register VAT taxpayer status (small-scale or general taxpayer), export tax rebate eligibility, and payroll/social insurance withholding registrations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: China does not permit check-the-box entity classification or hybrid entity elections for a WFOE; a WFOE is mandatorily a Chinese tax resident subject to enterprise income tax on worldwide income. Available elections affecting tax characterization include: (i) election between small-scale VAT taxpayer and general VAT taxpayer status upon exceeding or approaching the RMB 5 million annual turnover threshold; (ii) election of preferential enterprise income tax treatment applicable to small low-profit enterprises, high-tech enterprises, and key software enterprises; (iii) election to use the cross-border e-commerce retail export customs modes 9610/9710/9810 and the corresponding tax exemption/refund mechanism; and (iv) election of the foreign tax credit method under the Enterprise Income Tax Law. Anti-hybrid mismatch rules apply mandatorily; there is no elective hybrid regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Business Tax (加值型與非加值型營業稅) — Taiwan's value-added and non-value-added business tax system
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: NT$480,000 per year for foreign sellers providing electronic services to Taiwanese consumers. For a foreign seller of physical goods with no fixed place of business, branch, or warehouse in Taiwan, no Taiwan Business Tax registration is required; Taiwan Customs collects import Business Tax at the 5% rate on each physical consignment at clearance, including low-value express parcels under the official express clearance regime. If the WFOE establishes any fixed place of business, branch, or fulfillment warehouse in Taiwan, Business Tax registration is compulsory from the first day of such operation without any turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Taiwan registered businesses must issue Uniform Invoices (電子統一發票 or paper Uniform Invoice) for all taxable sales and upload electronic invoice data to the Ministry of Finance E-Invoice Integration Service Platform within 48 hours. For cross-border goods importation, Taiwan Customs requires electronic advance manifest filing and real-time express clearance data transmission by couriers and customs brokers. A foreign seller with no Taiwan fixed place of business is not subject to Taiwan e-invoicing for direct consumer shipments; if the seller gains Taiwan nexus through a branch or warehouse, local sales become subject to e-invoicing, quarterly VAT filing, and full fiscal document retention.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Chinese VAT law, Taiwan is a separate customs territory for export purposes. The WFOE may claim the zero-rated export VAT treatment and input VAT refund (export tax rebate) on baby and maternity supplies exported to Taiwan provided that: (i) the WFOE is registered as a VAT general taxpayer and has obtained export tax rebate qualification; (ii) the goods are physically exported from China under an approved customs export declaration code (general trade or cross-border e-commerce retail export mode 9610/9710/9810); (iii) the goods are sold to a Taiwan buyer and actually leave China; (iv) export sales proceeds are collected in China through a licensed bank or designated payment institution, including settled funds originating from Stripe or PayPal; and (v) complete input VAT invoices and supporting payment documents are retained. The cross-border e-commerce retail export mode may instead use the 'exempt and not refund' (免征不退) mechanism when input VAT invoices are incomplete, meaning no VAT is charged at export but no input credit or refund is available.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration Form (出口貨物報關單) with approved export record
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill evidencing physical shipment from China and arrival in Taiwan
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank foreign exchange settlement certificate (银行结汇水单) or equivalent digital payment settlement statement for Stripe/PayPal collections
Commercial export invoice and packing list
VAT Special Invoices (增值稅專用發票) and input VAT payment vouchers supporting the refund calculation
Export tax rebate declaration form and e-tax filing receipt
Purchase order, sales contract, or e-commerce order log identifying Taiwan consumers
Cross-border e-commerce retail export declaration list and transaction manifests when using 9610/9710/9810 mode
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Chinese tax authorities conduct post-refund audits of export declarations, logistics trails, and foreign exchange repatriation. If an export zero-rating claim is found to be fictitious, mispriced, or non-repatriated within the statutory period, the exporter must repay the full VAT refund plus interest. Under Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, fraudulent export refunds attract a penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax and retrospective clawback across the preceding five years. Serious violations are prosecuted under Article 204 of the Criminal Law for export tax refund fraud, with penalties including substantial criminal fines and imprisonment up to life imprisonment. Repeated or large-scale fraud additionally disqualifies the exporter from simplified cross-border e-commerce export refund procedures and triggers enhanced scrutiny of all related-party transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation and the competent local Administration for Market Regulation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June each year for the preceding financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted filing may result in inclusion in the abnormal-operation list and public credit-record consequences; regulatory fines may apply. Three consecutive years of non-compliance may result in inclusion on the serious illegal and untrustworthy list and eventual licence-revocation or compulsory deregistration risk; China has no automatic annual-return strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation through the annual enterprise information reporting system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Normally submitted together with the annual enterprise information report by 30 June each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to report or inaccurate reporting may cause abnormal-operation listing, public credit consequences, corrective orders, and administrative penalties; repeated non-compliance may contribute to licence-revocation proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent local tax authority under the State Taxation Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 31 May following the relevant tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest, tax collection measures, filing penalties, tax-credit downgrading, invoice restrictions, and inspection risk may apply. Material non-compliance may trigger additional administrative penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual value-added tax and other periodic tax filings
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent local tax authority under the State Taxation Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly or quarterly according to the registered tax filing cycle; annual reconciliation applies where prescribed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties, late-payment interest, tax recovery, tax-credit consequences, invoice restrictions, and tax audits may apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual foreign-exchange and cross-border investment compliance reporting, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange or its authorised local branch, and designated reporting channels
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Timing follows the applicable annual foreign-exchange reporting notice and local implementation calendar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Corrective orders, reporting restrictions, foreign-exchange administrative penalties, enhanced monitoring, and limitations on cross-border capital transactions may apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory financial statements and audit report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Maintained for tax, market-regulation, banking, and other regulatory inspection; submitted where required by the competent authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Prepared after financial year-end and generally completed before annual corporate income tax reconciliation and annual enterprise reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare or maintain required financial statements may result in accounting-law penalties, tax adjustments, inspection findings, and restrictions on regulatory filings or capital transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A PRC wholly foreign-owned enterprise is generally subject to annual statutory financial statement audit without a turnover or asset threshold. Additional audits may be required for liquidation, deregistration, capital changes, special tax matters, regulated activities, or local authority requests.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Chinese Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises, with applicable PRC accounting laws, regulations, and tax rules. IFRS may be used for group reporting but does not replace mandatory PRC statutory accounting and tax filings.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China generally does not require a separate annual UBO confirmation filing. The company should conduct an annual internal confirmation of ownership and control, reconcile shareholder and beneficial-owner data, and promptly update the statutory beneficial-owner information report and relevant registers after any change. The China beneficial-owner information reporting regime applies to covered entities and requires accurate maintenance and updating of reported information.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors, and Senior Management

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 500-3,000 annually for compliant registered-office, corporate-secretarial, and filing-support services; a physical PRC registered office is generally required, and pricing varies substantially by city and premises arrangements.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 1,500-8,000 for a straightforward small WFOE annual statutory audit; complex operations, inventory, e-commerce revenue, related-party transactions, or major-city firms may exceed USD 10,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Base rate 25% under PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law Art. 4. Preferential rates available to WFOE: 15% for certified High and New Technology Enterprise (HNTE) where R&D intensity, tech personnel ratio, and core IP tests are met; 5% effective rate for Small Low-Profit Enterprise (annual taxable income no more than RMB 3 million, employees no more than 300, total assets no more than RMB 50 million, policy extended through 2027); 100% additional super deduction for qualifying R&D expenses; 10% rate for key software enterprises with 2-year exemption plus 3-year half-rate period in designated zones; foreign-invested e-commerce distribution functions normally do not qualify for HNTE unless proprietary software or platform technology is owned and developed in China.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A200000 Quarterly Corporate Income Tax Prepayment Return, filed via the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau (SAT e-Tax portal, dianzi shuiwuju)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 calendar days after each quarter-end: April 15, July 15, October 15, and January 15 of the following year; computed on year-to-date accounting profit under PRC GAAP.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1 - Actual profit for the period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Year-to-date accounting pre-tax profit of the WFOE, the default quarterly prepayment base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The resident WFOE reports its worldwide accounting profit; no non-resident shareholder items are entered on this form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 12 - Tax payable at statutory rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 1 multiplied by 25%, prior to incentives, loss carryforward, and foreign tax credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the statutory rate; reduced rates require on-file preferential tax filing with the in-charge tax bureau.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of preferential rate benefit claimed, e.g., 15% HNTE or 5% small-profit rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only if the qualifying certificate or small-profit assessment is valid and disclosed to the tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prepayable amount after deducting prior quarter prepayments within the same year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Excess prepayment is credited against the annual settlement; no separate non-resident payment applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Understated or late quarterly prepayment attracts a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of the shortfall (Tax Collection Administration Law Art. 32); late filing is punishable by a fine up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 in serious cases (TCAL Art. 62).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (annual settlement and clearance, huisuan qingjiao), together with Schedule A105000 Tax Adjustment Detail Table and related schedules, filed via the SAT e-Tax portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before May 31 of the year following the calendar tax year (within 5 months after the December 31 fiscal year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross online retail sales of maternity and infant care commodities, net of returns and trade discounts, stated exclusive of VAT, including all Stripe, PayPal, WeChat Pay, and Alipay settlement receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile platform payout reports to the statutory general ledger; unregistered platform-side revenue is a primary audit trigger.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct cost of goods sold, inbound logistics, warehousing, and packaging attributable to recognized revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support with purchase contracts, customs declarations, and VAT special invoices; cross-border related-party purchases must comply with the arm's length standard.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit before tax per the statutory financial statements, after selling, administrative, and financial expenses, plus non-operating income and expense.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must reconcile to the audited financial statements; SAT data analytics cross-check platform settlement data against reported totals.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-backs including non-deductible entertainment excess, related-party interest limitation, non-compliant donations, impairment provisions, asset valuation gains, and transfer-pricing adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document every intercompany benchmark within the Local File; unsupported add-backs create special tax adjustment exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions including the 100% R&D super deduction, accelerated tax depreciation, and prior-year overprovisions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain project files, HNTE qualification evidence, and time sheets; digital e-commerce R&D claims are closely scrutinized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of taxable losses from prior years within the 5-year general window (10 years for HNTE and small low-profit enterprises).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses reported and assessed in prior CIT filings may be used; intercompany pricing manipulations that create artificial losses are recharacterized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after adjustments and loss offsets; the base to which the applicable rate is applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A zero or negative taxable income does not exempt the WFOE from filing; supporting schedules are mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final annual tax liability less quarterly prepayments and foreign tax credits; payment due on the filing deadline.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Refund claims are filed via the e-Tax portal; overpayments bear no statutory interest in favor of the taxpayer.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual filing: TCAL Art. 62 fines; late payment: 0.05% daily surcharge; underpayment due to concealment of revenue is treated as tax evasion under TCAL Art. 63 with a penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax, plus criminal referral under Criminal Law Art. 201 where the amount exceeds RMB 50,000 and represents more than 10% of the tax payable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Related-Party Transaction Reporting Form (the 18-schedule related-party disclosure package, guanlian yewu laiwang baogao biao), filed via the SAT e-Tax portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed together with the annual CIT return no later than May 31; no extension is available for this package.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of the Taiwan parent, ultimate beneficial owner, direct and indirect shareholding percentages, and the nature of control.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all Taiwan-resident entities in the group; omission triggers an automatic transfer-pricing audit flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregated tangible goods purchases, trademark and technology royalties, management service fees, and financial guarantees with the Taiwan parent and affiliates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report amounts in RMB; convert Taiwan dollar transactions at the PBOC central parity rate applicable on the transaction date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of CUP, resale price, cost plus, TNMM, or profit split with benchmark comparables and interquartile range results.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must justify the tested party selection and the arm's length margin; high-margin brand intangibles normally remain with the parent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to submit the related-party package reverses the burden of proof in a transfer-pricing audit, triggers interest at the PBOC benchmark plus 5 percentage points on any upward adjustment (SAT Notice 2012 No. 34), and exposes the WFOE to a penalty of up to 500% of the underpaid tax where misstatement is deliberate.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on gross dividends distributed by the PRC resident WFOE to its Taiwan-resident corporate shareholder (PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law Art. 3(3) and Implementation Regulation Art. 91); the WFOE acts as statutory withholding agent and must remit the tax within 7 days of the distribution resolution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke the 5% reduced dividend rate under the Cross-Strait Double Taxation Agreement (signed 2015): (1) obtain a Taiwan Tax Resident Certificate (TRC) from the Taiwan Ministry of Finance; (2) the WFOE files the Non-Resident Enterprise Withholding Income Tax Return together with the Application for Enjoyment of Tax Treaty Treatment and the beneficial-ownership declaration required by SAT Public Notice 2018 No. 9; (3) prove that the Taiwan parent directly holds at least 25% of the WFOE capital and is the beneficial owner, not a conduit. Practical caveat: Taiwan has suspended domestic implementation of the 2015 agreement, PRC collection authorities may demand 10% pending competent authority consultation, and the Taiwan parent may not be able to credit the PRC WHT in Taiwan, creating economic double taxation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding: 10% on gross interest and 10% on gross royalties paid by the WFOE to a Taiwan non-resident recipient. Under the Cross-Strait DTA, the caps are 7% on interest and 3% on royalties, available only upon submission of the Taiwan TRC and proof of beneficial ownership; where treaty status is not established, the domestic 10% rate applies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory when stated related-party transactions in a single fiscal year exceed RMB 100 million for tangible goods, RMB 40 million for intangible property transfers or other transactions, and RMB 20 million for financial asset transfers; Master File is required when prior-year related-party revenue reaches RMB 2 billion; Country-by-Country Report is required when the consolidated group revenue reaches RMB 5.5 billion (SAT Public Notice 2016 No. 42).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: PRC law has no GCC-style Economic Substance Regulations, but substantive economic presence is enforced through: (1) the beneficial-ownership test in SAT Public Notice 2018 No. 9, which denies treaty withholding relief to letterbox or conduit companies lacking personnel, premises, decision-making functions, and risk absorption; (2) the general anti-avoidance rule under EIT Law Art. 47 permitting recharacterization of arrangements without commercial substance; and (3) the transfer-pricing function, asset, and risk analysis under BEPS 13 requiring that China-located profits correspond to China-located employees and activities. The WFOE must maintain an actual office, operating staff, and board decisions in China to support its profit allocation and treaty claims.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting Stripe, PayPal, or platform settlement revenue from the WFOE books, diverting collections to personal WeChat or Alipay accounts, fabricating purchase invoices, or creating shell suppliers to inflate costs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TCAL Art. 63 penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax plus a 0.05% daily surcharge; criminal liability under Criminal Law Art. 201 where the evaded amount exceeds RMB 50,000 and is more than 10% of the tax payable, with imprisonment up to 7 years and fines; SAT blacklisting and coordinated credit and exit restrictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, financial officer, and de facto controller face joint civil restitution of the tax shortfall, freezing of personal assets, exit bans, and criminal detention; the corporate veil is pierced where shareholder and company funds are commingled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the China WFOE as a nominee structure with no employees, premises, or business activity in China, or routing dividend distributions through a Taiwan conduit solely to claim the 5% Cross-Strait DTA rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits, recharacterization under the GAAR (EIT Law Art. 47), supplementary withholding tax to 10%, interest on under-withheld amounts, and a penalty up to 500% of the underpaid tax where the abuse is deliberate; public disclosure as a tax-abuse case.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false beneficial-ownership declarations may be personally assessed for the recovered tax and face criminal exposure for aiding tax evasion; travel bans and asset preservation orders apply to the controlling shareholders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing or purchasing fraudulent special VAT invoices to inflate input credits or supplier costs in the resale of maternity and infant commodities, or using fake invoice mills to manufacture sales volume.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal Law Art. 205 imposes imprisonment from 3 years to life and confiscation of property for false issuance of special VAT invoices; the tax authority imposes a penalty of 50% to 500% of the tax involved, revokes VAT qualifications, and publishes the violation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, financial controller, and the staff member who arranged the false invoices are jointly and severally liable for restitution and face primary criminal prosecution; exit bans and mutual legal assistance exposure apply to fugitive directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the WFOE at persistent thin margins or losses while the Taiwan parent records the TNMM-style residual profit; paying unjustified management fees or royalties without substantive services or IP; failing to prepare or submit the Local File.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Special tax adjustment reallocating income, deemed interest at the PBOC benchmark rate plus 5 percentage points on the underpaid tax, back-assessment over 10 years, and a penalty up to 500% of the underpaid tax where documentation is absent or false.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed inaccurate transfer-pricing returns or stripped the WFOE of assets before assessment can be personally liable for the recovered taxes; no statutory cap shields directors in fraud cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Retaining cross-border e-commerce sales proceeds in offshore bank accounts, using underground or informal payment channels, under-invoicing exports to leave funds abroad, or failing to comply with SAFE settlement and registration requirements for trade receivables.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations Art. 39 impose a penalty of up to 30% of the illegal foreign exchange amount plus confiscation of illegal gains; criminal money laundering under Criminal Law Art. 191 carries up to 10 years of imprisonment and fines where funds are disguised or layered.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Controlling shareholders and finance directors who instructed the under-reporting face personal travel bans, asset freezes, director disqualification, and criminal detention; cross-border asset recovery is pursued through mutual legal assistance channels.
